purpose: Training-free temporal backcasting diagnostic; do not infer its result from M1 failure
teacher_extraction: Local maxima as evaluate.peaks with existing logit floor -12, then inclusive logit>=0; retain exact-zero logits. Deterministic score desc/y/x order before top300. No early-frame values are used for proposals.
association: At each teacher frame, Hungarian maximum-valid-cardinality/minimum-distance one-to-one match to last observations; dt<=3 and Euclidean distance<=10*dt. Invalid assignments have cost exceeding the maximum sum of valid costs and are discarded. Unmatched detections start new tracks; no GT IDs or GT speed.
fitting: For a track with first detection t0, use only observations with t in [t0,t0+39]. Require >=10 observations spanning >=9 frames. raw_stop uses coordinatewise median; raw_cv uses time-centered OLS x/y. Each model independently requires Euclidean RMS residual<=3px on the same fit observations. Never choose a model using GT.
projection: Each accepted track predicts every frame 0..59 with no horizon truncation. Preserve every raw projected point and finite/in-image/NMS status. Non-finite/out-of-image points are recorded, not submitted as image candidates.
candidate_nms: Separate per model/frame; rank by descending fit-point count, descending median teacher logit, then deterministic track ID. Suppress points at Euclidean distance<=3px from a retained point, recording suppressor.
generation_isolation: Generate from NPY arrays (shape supplies frame count/H/W), cached prediction metadata and this plan only. Do not load Scene, boxes, masks, targets.csv, or any GT in generation. Seal tracks/teacher_points/points plus SHA256 in manifest before evaluation; evaluate in a separate process.
evaluation: Match all retained image candidates to all GT box centres one-to-one with maximum-valid-cardinality/minimum Euclidean distance<=3px. Matching is independent of baseline hit/miss. Every unmatched candidate is wrong, including duplicates, distances3..8px and frames without GT; no exclusion band.
metrics: early original misses recovered and recovery fraction
actual wrong image candidates per early frame
post-hoc teacher coverage and track purity
teacher_coverage: Evaluation only: match teacher detections to GT by the same3px one-to-one rule. Report any later teacher for each early GT track, and >=10 matched fit observations in one independently accepted predicted track. Never use coverage/purity to filter predictions.
limitations: Primary unit is GT box, not merged official connected component.
M2 uses Euclidean3px; M1 used Chebyshev3px.
Missing annotations are not assumed to be real targets: unmatched predictions count as wrong under supplied GT.
Long backcasting and identity ambiguity may fail; report distances and all false candidates.
Both stop/CV results are reported; no GT-driven choice or parameter tuning.
source_policy: No GPU, no model inference, no training, no image-based proposals, no homography in this diagnostic.
baseline_source_amendment: Before any real M2 generation: byte-identical frozen copy requested by root to avoid M1 rerun/archive races; no algorithm parameters changed.
